## What

Widen `_OPERATOR_ATTESTED_TAG_RE` (`src/rebar/llm/plan_review/det_operator_attested.py:45`) to
`\[(?:non-codebase|operator-attested)\]`, and widen the `.rebar/criteria_routing.json:75`
activation trigger `text_all` to match either spelling.

## Why this is the keystone

FIVE consumers share the IDENTICAL compiled regex object, so one pattern change propagates to
all of them with no new branch anywhere. Four read it with normal semantics — `decide_ops`,
`workflow_ops`, `det_attestation_launder`, `det_measurement_provenance` (each satisfies `is`
against `det_operator_attested._OPERATOR_ATTESTED_TAG_RE`).

The FIFTH is `src/rebar/_commands/txn.py:544-547` (`ensure_ac_boxes_checked`), and its semantics
are INVERTED: a match REMOVES an unchecked AC line from the set that blocks a ticket close
(`offenders = [ln for ln in floor.unchecked_ac_lines if not _OPERATOR_ATTESTED_TAG_RE.match(ln)]`).
Widening the matcher therefore also makes an unchecked `[non-codebase]`-tagged AC close-exempt.
That is INTENDED — the exemption is the tag's whole purpose and must reach both spellings or the
rename would silently strip it — but it is a close-gate behavior change, so it is stated here and
pinned by an AC below rather than left implicit.

Because no new branch is introduced anywhere, `det_floor.py` (793/800 LOC cap) and
`decide_ops.plan_review_decide` (complexity 21, grandfathered) need no edits and their gates do
not fire.

## Vocabulary is defined before code accepts it

ADR-0043 makes exact-token matching a deliberate FAIL-SAFE: anything that is not the exact tag is
treated as codebase-verifiable, so a garbled tag falls back to the STRICTER bar. Accepting a
second spelling relaxes that fail-safe, so the relaxation must be a recorded decision, not an
undocumented one. This story therefore DEPENDS ON S8 (ADR 0101), which defines `[non-codebase]`,
records why `operator` mis-signalled, and states that `[operator-attested]` is retained as an
undocumented alias. S8 lands first; this story implements the decision S8 records.

## Trap

The alternation MUST be non-capturing. `decide_ops.operator_attested_ac_texts` uses `findall()`,
which returns TUPLES if the group captures, silently breaking Pass-3 enrichment.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] `_OPERATOR_ATTESTED_TAG_RE` matches `- [x] [non-codebase] x` and `- [x] [operator-attested] x`
      case-insensitively, and does NOT match the `[operator_attested]` underscore near-miss.
- [x] `operator_attested_ac_texts` returns a `list[str]` (not tuples) for a description mixing
      both spellings, proved by a test asserting element types.
- [x] The `.rebar/criteria_routing.json` `project.measurement-provenance` trigger fires on a
      plan tagged `[non-codebase]` and on one tagged `[operator-attested]`, proved by a test.
- [x] An unchecked `- [x] [non-codebase] …` AC item is EXEMPT from the `ensure_ac_boxes_checked`
      close block exactly as an `[operator-attested]` one is, and an unchecked UNTAGGED item
      still blocks — pinning the inverted-semantics consumer at `txn.py:547`.
- [x] ADR 0101 (S8) is landed and defines `[non-codebase]` before this matcher accepts it.
- [x] All existing tests pass unchanged.
